description: This file implements the PduComposer class responsible for constructing various types of MMS PDUs (Protocol Data Units) such as SendReq, NotifyResp, and AckInd. It handles encoding of message headers, content, and related data structures as per the MMS/WSP specifications.

classes.name: PduComposer
classes.description: A class responsible for composing MMS PDUs, including setting headers, content, and encoding the message according to MMS specifications.

classes.name: BufferStack
classes.description: Inner class that manages a stack of ByteArrayOutputStreams used during message composition to handle nested parts and lengths.

classes.name: LengthRecordNode
classes.description: Inner class representing a node in the stack managing message length recording.

classes.name: PositionMarker
classes.description: Inner class used to mark a position in the message stream and stack size during composition.

methods.name: make
methods.description: Constructs the complete PDU message byte array based on the message type, encoding headers and content.

methods.name: arraycopy
methods.description: Copies a byte array segment into the current message buffer.

methods.name: append
methods.description: Appends a single byte value to the message buffer.

methods.name: appendShortInteger
methods.description: Encodes and appends a short integer to the message buffer.

methods.name: appendOctet
methods.description: Appends an octet (byte) to the message buffer.

methods.name: appendShortLength
methods.description: Appends a short length value to the message buffer.

methods.name: appendLongInteger
methods.description: Encodes and appends a long integer to the message buffer.

methods.name: appendTextString
methods.description: Encodes and appends a text string to the message buffer.

methods.name: appendEncodedString
methods.description: Encodes and appends an EncodedStringValue object to the message buffer.

methods.name: appendUintvarInteger
methods.description: Encodes and appends a uintvar integer to the message buffer.

methods.name: appendDateValue
methods.description: Encodes and appends a date value to the message buffer.

methods.name: appendValueLength
methods.description: Encodes and appends a value length to the message buffer.

methods.name: appendQuotedString
methods.description: Encodes and appends a quoted string to the message buffer.

methods.name: appendAddressType
methods.description: Appends address type information to an EncodedStringValue representing an address.

methods.name: appendHeader
methods.description: Encodes and appends a specific message header field, handling its value accordingly.

methods.name: makeReadRecInd
methods.description: Builds the ReadRec.Ind message PDU.

methods.name: makeNotifyResp
methods.description: Builds the NotifyResp.Ind message PDU.

methods.name: makeAckInd
methods.description: Builds the Acknowledge.Ind message PDU.

methods.name: makeSendReqPdu
methods.description: Builds the SendReq message PDU, including headers and message body.

methods.name: makeMessageBody
methods.description: Constructs the message body segment of the PDU, including multimedia parts.

methods.name: checkAddressType
methods.description: Determines the type of address (phone number, email, IPv4, IPv6) based on regex matching.
